name: Healing Helps
verdict: Healing Helps had zero paid spend or leads over the past 28 days, so all activity came from organic sources, with Google Business Profile driving 27 total actions (2 calls, 14 directions, 11 web clicks) across 25 active days. performance.verdict: Organic-only footing stable; GBP up but web traffic collapsing demands attention.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across the full 45-day series; CPL is undefined — no paid efficiency signal exists to evaluate.
SC clicks and GA4 sessions both fell ~41% week-over-week (37 clicks / 189 sessions in 28 days) while GBP impressions held at 329, suggesting a site or indexing issue, not a visibility collapse.

GBP actions surged 50% week-over-week to 27 total (2 calls, 14 directions, 11 web clicks), but last-3-day GBP actions are 0 vs prior-3-day total of 0 — the spike was concentrated around Aug 25 (11 actions) and has since gone flat.
GA4 recorded 0 conversions across 189 sessions and 28 days; with no paid traffic, conversion tracking may be misconfigured or goal events are not firing.

suggestions.text: Audit site and Search Console for crawl errors causing the ~41% SC/GA4 drop; no budget required.
suggestions.monday_update: Search Console clicks fell ~41% week-over-week (from ~63 to 37 in 28 days) while GBP impressions held steady at 329, pointing to a site crawl or indexing issue rather than a loss of local visibility. Pull the Search Console Coverage report for crawl errors, check for any recent site changes, and confirm robots.txt or noindex tags are not blocking key pages. Success check: SC clicks recover above 60/week by 2026-09-25. Re-check on 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP action rate daily; Aug 25 spike (11 actions) has not recurred — confirm if post/event drove it.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 11 in a single day on Aug 25, lifting the 7-day total 50% week-over-week, but the last several days show 0 actions. Identify what content, post, or external factor drove that spike. If it was a GBP post, replicate it. Success check: average daily GBP actions return to ≥1/day by 2026-09-18. Re-check on 2026-09-18.
